subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: Why are you putting up the food in your pocket why don't you eat asked the noble man i am doing the right thing replied sheikh saadi Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: “Why are you putting up the food in your pocket? Why don’t you eat?” asked the noble man. “I’m doing the right thing," replied Sheikh Saadi. Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 174
